text: The query manager starts queryFolders and queryAccounts at null when the criterion is absent. A supplied array is normalized without replacing an empty array, and the online path uses queryAccounts ?? allAccounts. Thus a missing account criterion uses the default accounts, while an explicitly empty list stays empty in this source. Keep the absent-value sentinel and the supplied collection separate when choosing fallback syntax. This is a scoped implementation contract, not a rule to use ?? for every default. The new matrix tests order and suppression, but does not cover an empty-array query; that runtime case remains untested here.
title: Keep omitted query criteria distinct from an explicitly empty array
